journal_lines: Twisted trunks in the savanna heat.
Dead acacia still standing. Bark stripped clean by antlers.
The roots tore the ground when it went over.
Acacia roots go deep enough to find water nothing else finds. The tree knows things.
Heat shimmered above the grass all morning. The axe got hot in the paw.
A vulture circled while I worked. Patient bird. Disappointed bird.
The long shadow of a single tree was longer than expected. Cut it from the long side.
Wood inside the acacia was redder than the bark suggested. Bled, almost.
Thorns on the branches like a row of bad teeth. Took my time.
